title: Question
description: A single generated interview question with hint and evidence. Produced by Task 3 (generation).

text.description: The interview question as an interviewer would ask it.

hint.description: Topics to cover. NOT a model answer.

type.description: Whether this is a project-based or experience-based question.

project_id.description: The project this question is about. Null for experience-based questions not tied to one project.

kind.description: chunk = resume/readme/student text; experience = interview experience entry.

ref_id.description: chunk_id for kind=chunk, experience id for kind=experience.

quote.description: Exact text from the source (ignoring extra spaces and case). Must appear verbatim in the referenced text.

evidence.description: At least one evidence item. Project questions have one (chunk). Experience-based questions have two (chunk + experience).
